subject: Maintaining Table State for Table Linked to reactiveFileReader

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Maintaining Table State for Table Linked to reactiveFileReader
parts: If a data table has rows selected and filtering text entered for some columns, but it is linked to a reactive data source, such as a file which has more data records incrementally added to it, can the selections and filters be easily maintained, when the file reading event is triggered and the table is refreshed ?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Maintaining Table State for Table Linked to reactiveFileReader
parts:
There is one subtle issue here: if you update the data, the filters
may have to be updated as well, e.g. the min/max values for a numeric
column may have changed, so the slider has to be replaced.

Regards,
Yihui
